{{Top|leg}}
'''Sargheet''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of crop [[Plant/Legends|plant]] grown on the [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dagro]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Half a year before the [[Mission to Dagro]], in which [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] fought [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] occupying the planet, the market for Sargheet was greatly reduced. This financial difficulty for many [[Farmer/Legends|farmers]] on Dagro including [[Kilran Swens]] and his family as 70% of their crop was Sargheet. Sargheet stubble, the part of the crop left after harvesting, was eaten by [[Zele]]s a species of animal used for transport by the Swens family.

{{Flora-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Sargheet was created by author [[Timothy Zahn]] for his two part short story ''[[Changing Seasons]]'' in which it was mentioned in both parts of the story, ''Guardian of the People'' published in [[Star Wars Insider 76|''Star Wars Insider'' 76]] and ''People of the Guardian'' published in [[Star Wars Insider 77|''Star Wars Insider'' 77]].
